discovery_notes: All claims from search snippets only. DLP 2019 LE pins reserved via Lineberty app. Monthly DPB roundups (Jan-Dec 2019) list themes but no pin names; full WDWNT/DPB pages would yield many more pins. pinsbreaktheinternet and disneypinforum claims are weak leads (reseller/forum). Lion King jumbo pin year not confirmed. Captain Marvel OE $9.99 pin was DLR/WDW, not recorded.
